dogecoin.text: @Robotbeat Last night when I was trying to watch I found a stream by a dogecoin enthusiast. He didn’t know even basic facts about Elon (I don’t think he knew he had an EV company) and didn’t know the basic premise of SNL. He was SOOO confused (steam got yanked after the monologue).

Ok, let’s get real. Dogecoin didn’t drop because Elon said it was a hustle (everyone knows that was a joke). It dropped because its followers actually thought he would go on there and earnestly say that everyone should buy it. And they had priced that in.
